headword: {抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}

definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing something so extremely funny that one holds one's belly and falls over laughing.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}に{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}した。
examples.english: I was in stitches from his story.

examples.japanese: {抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}のコメディだった。
{観客|かんきゃく}は{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}だった。
examples.english: The audience was rolling with laughter.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

LITERAL MEANING: {抱腹|ほうふく} (to hold one's belly) + {絶倒|ぜっとう} (to fall over) = To hold one's belly and fall over from laughing so hard.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}する (to laugh uproariously)
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}の＋noun (a hilarious ~)
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}ものだ (it's hilarious)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}のコメディ (hilarious comedy)
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}の{話|はなし} (side-splitting story)
・{抱腹絶倒|ほうふくぜっとう}もの (something hilarious)

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
・Side-splitting
・Rolling on the floor laughing
・In stitches

RELATED TERMS:
・{爆笑|ばくしょう} - roaring laughter
・{大笑|おおわら}い - big laugh
・{腹|はら}を{抱|かか}える - to hold one's sides (laughing)
